delivery.outcome: A deterministic POA/CQRS/Event Sourcing control plane that validates Protobuf-backed log DSL streams and requires one actionable errors/{CODE}.md definition per stable code
nonGoals: Do not implement a general-purpose logging backend, collector or message broker
Do not accept arbitrary payloads, raw output, credentials, shell commands or transport configuration
Do not let an LLM-authored request append events, create authority or waive findings
Do not rewrite or delete published event history automatically
Do not publish a tag or release in this ticket

architecture.decision: Use Protobuf as the canonical type system, one closed contract bundle for JSON projections and propose-only GBNF, canonical hash-chained JSONL for event sourcing, structured error Markdown with embedded DSL, and a dependency-free deterministic validator as the decision boundary
dataChanges: Introduce wellmanifest.logs/v1 command, query, event, error, finding, projection and receipt messages
Introduce canonical JSONL event streams with sequence and SHA-256 predecessor chaining
Introduce embedded wellmanifest.logs/error/v1 definitions at errors/{CODE}.md
architecture.rollback: Revert the five implementation files before merge; after integration preserve history and issue a compensating contract version rather than rewriting published event streams
